# Knowledge library (کتابخانه‌ی دانش) — start here

> Built 2026-10-25 by scripts/build_llms.py. Short router; the full list of every document and
> every tool by verdict is llms-full.txt (open it only when you need to search the whole library).

1. Read projects/user-profile.md (the user's taste, budget rules, guards) before choosing anything.
2. Classify the task with the routes below, open that one file, follow it.
3. Verdicts: adopt ✅ use · trial 🧪 small test first · assess 👀 not yet · hold ⛔ never. Never copy
   others' designs, prompts or code; only clearly licensed assets. File new findings back (CLAUDE.md).

## Routes

| Task | Open |
|---|---|
| Any project: which playbook | playbooks/README.md |
| Design an app (any kind, Android + iOS) | domains/apps/app-design-system.md, then app-styles.md and app-screen-patterns.md |
| Start the code of a Flutter app | starters/flutter-app/README.md |
| A link, post, reel or tool to check | research/x-research-plan.md (+ scripts/fetch_post.py) |
| Is a tool still current / ready for a better verdict | scripts/check_updates.py and its report in research/inbox/ |
| Claude Code cost, safety, plugins, MCP, parallel work | domains/claude-code/README.md |
| Set up a new machine like the main one | projects/new-machine.md (+ scripts/setup_machine.py) |
| Find a tool by name or category | catalog/README.md or catalog/index.json |
| A source ID (S12) | sources/S12.md |

## Playbooks

- راهنمای پروژه: هوش مصنوعی در محصول و عامل خودکار: playbooks/ai-feature-agent.md
- راهنمای پروژه: برند و لوگو: playbooks/brand-identity.md
- راهنمای پروژه: سایت کسب‌وکار: playbooks/business-website.md
- راهنمای پروژه: اپ دسکتاپ Windows، macOS و Linux: playbooks/desktop-app.md
- راهنمای پروژه: اپ شبکه‌ی محلی در خود کسب‌وکار: playbooks/local-business-app.md
- راهنمای پروژه: اپ موبایل iOS و Android: playbooks/mobile-app.md
- راهنمای پروژه: فروشگاه آنلاین: playbooks/online-store.md
- راهنمای پروژه: محتوای شبکه‌های اجتماعی: playbooks/social-content.md
- راهنمای پروژه: داشبورد و نرم‌افزار وب: playbooks/web-app-dashboard.md

## Domains

- وبسایت: domains/website/README.md
- اپلیکیشن (موبایل و دسکتاپ، چندسکویی): domains/apps/README.md
- شبکه‌های اجتماعی (ویدیو، عکس، پست، صدا): domains/social-media/README.md
- Claude Code (هزینه، امنیت، کار موازی، بررسی، دستیار): domains/claude-code/README.md

Counts: 308 tool cards, 60 documents. Sync: python3 scripts/sync.py at start and end.
